summary: Hay'adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA) ayaa sheegtay in 23-kii Oktoobar lagu dilay Kuunyo Barrow, Shabeellaha Hoose, Faysal Yuusuf Macallin oo loo yaqaan Gaagaale, oo ay sheegtay inuu madax ka ahaa maaliyadda kooxda 2014 ilaa 2024. Sheegashadan si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin.
title: NISA oo sheegtay in la dilay sarkaal hore oo maaliyadda Al-Shabaab ka masuul ahaa
